title: BUGFIX — /queue shows inflated count from duplicate video_ids in ledger
rationale: cmdQueue() at line 185 builds unposted from publish-ledger.jsonl without deduplicating by video_id. Same root cause as Sprint 1395 (/today). Ledger has multiple entries per video_id so unposted.length and readyCount are inflated, and top-5 may show duplicates. Fix: add seenVids Set in the filter, same pattern as Sprint 1395.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-content.ts cmdQueue(): add seenVids Set in the unposted filter to deduplicate by video_id before sort. Same pattern as Sprint 1395 fix to cmdToday().
